Aerial Guard.name: Aerial Guard
Aerial Guard.text:
Activates before being hit by a physickal attack.
Block an enemy attack with a medium guard. Becomes a heavy guard and grants the user +1 PP if the enemy is flying.

Bestral Guard.name: Bestral Guard
Bestral Guard.text:
Activates before being hit by a physickal attack.
Block an enemy attack with a medium guard. Becomes a heavy guard and grants the user +1 PP if the enemy is a bestral.

Cavalry Guard.name: Cavalry Guard
Cavalry Guard.text:
Activates before being hit by a physickal attack.
Block an enemy attack with a medium guard. Becomes a heavy guard and grants the user +1 PP if the enemy is cavalry.

Enduring Guard.name: Enduring Guard
Enduring Guard.text:
Activates before being hit by a physickal attack.
Block an enemy attack with a heavy guard. Grants the user a buff to endure one lethal blow.

Hastened Cover.name: Hastened Cover
Hastened Cover.text:
Activates before an ally is attacked.
Cover an ally with a medium guard. Grants that ally max Initiative for their next action.

Lifeshare.name: Lifeshare
Lifeshare.text:
Activates after an ally is hit by an attack.
Share HP with an ally. (50% of the user's HP).

Magick Wall.name: Magick Wall
Magick Wall.text: Grants the user a buff that negates one magick attack or one affliction.

Nocturnal Guard.name: Nocturnal Guard
Nocturnal Guard.text:
Activates before being hit by a physickal attack.
Block an enemy attack with a medium guard. Grants the user +1 PP at night.

Quick Cover.name: Quick Cover
Quick Cover.text:
Activates before an ally is attacked.
Cover an ally with a medium guard.

Radiant Cover.name: Radiant Cover
Radiant Cover.text:
Activates before an ally is attacked.
Cover an ally with a medium guard. Makes that ally's next attack a truestrike.

Royal Guard.name: Royal Guard
Royal Guard.text:
Activates before being hit by a physickal attack.
Block an enemy attack with a medium guard. User recovers 25% HP.

Wall.name: Wall
Wall.text: Grants the user a buff that negates one physickal attack.
